rightIconTitle.value:
Total money invested in your campaign
 across all channels. Represents your 
complete financial commitment
 to the marketing effort.

The main goal of your campaign, such as 
increasing driving sales, generating 
leads, or brand awareness.

Specific outcomes achieved by your 
campaign based on your objective. 
Measures actual performance against 
campaign goals and quantifies return 
on marketing investment.

CPL - Cost Per Lead
Average cost needed to achieve your specific
 campaign objective. Measures efficiency 
of spend relative to your desired outcome.

This typically refers to the current state of the 
ad campaign, such as "active," "paused," 
"deleted," or "archived."

This refers to the total number
 of times your ad is shown to 
users. It doesn't mean that 
users clicked on the ad, just
 that it was visible to them.

CPC - Cost Per Click
Average amount paid for each click on your ad. 
Lower values indicate more cost-effective engagement.

CTR - Click Through Rate
Percentage of impressions resulting in clicks, 
calculated as (clicks÷impressions)×100. 
Indicates how compelling your ad is to viewers.

This represents the number of times users 
clicked on your ad. It's an important indicator 
of how engaging or relevant your ad is to the 
audience.

Reach is the total number of unique users 
who saw your ad. Unlike impressions, 
which count all views, reach only counts 
individual users once.
